messages:
rachel: Heads up — p95 decode jumped ~2.3x on canary after the prefetch rework merge (PR #4123). Seeing a host alloc spike and higher GPU memcpy count. Uploading perf snapshots shortly.
ci-bot: perf-suite: canary perf regression detected: decode_shortseq_p95 +130% vs baseline. Job: perf/decode-shortseq.
sam: starting bisect now. initial suspect: commit 7f9b2a which changed kv prefetch ordering and fused-op schedule.
anil: captured host heap profile + nvprof traces. Host mallocs up ~4x, GPU memcpy calls up significantly. Looks like prefetch path is issuing extra synchronous copies on short sequences.
maria: i can repro locally with the bench harness. command i used: `./tools/run_perf.sh --model redwood-7b --seq 32 --batch 1 --profile` — reproduces p95 spike for me.
rachel: uploaded flamegraph to the thread (flame.svg). top stack: `kv_prefetch()` -> `blend_dispatch()` -> `cudaMemcpy` -> `decode_loop`.
sam: quick grep in the PR showed this log entry in the new code: ```[worker0] kv_prefetch: issuing prefetch for key=... wait=true``` — that `wait=true` looks wrong for the warmup prefetch path.
anil: yep, PR added a `sync_prefetch` flag and set it unconditionally for safety. intended behavior was: sync only when shapes mismatch or on eviction-critical paths. appears we accidentally made shortseq warmups synchronous.
karen: deploy-bot shows canary error 503 on 2/8 instances at 13:21 UTC, CPU and p95 correlated. Rollout was auto-paused by the release pipeline.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused: canary failed perf check (threshold breach). Manual intervention required to resume.
sam: proposing quick mitigation: revert the unconditional sync in prefetch. i'll open a hotfix branch `hotfix/prefetch-async` and PR.
maria: alternative patch — add heuristic `PREFETCH_SYNC_THRESHOLD=64` so only sequences >64 trigger sync. that avoids shortseq regression but keeps correctness for long sequences.
rachel: can someone run the perf harness with `PREFETCH_SYNC_THRESHOLD=64` and report p95? if that restores baseline we can hotpatch config instead of full revert.
anil: ran synthetic perf with threshold=64: decode_p95 back within ~5% of baseline, memory peak up ~6% on the run. need e2e and KV eviction testing before rollout.
sam: opening PR now: https://git.internal/r/inference/runtime/pull/4188 — contains both revert of unconditional sync and optional env var to gate behavior.
maria: noted — perf CI will re-run. beware flaky tests can hide improvements; recommend running local harness with multiple seeds.
rachel: good. if hotfix passes canary we can resume staged rollout. keep revert branch handy if anything else crops up.
karen: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with oncall for 30m watch after resume and add a monitor dashboard for `prefetch.sync_count` and `cuda_memcpy_count`.
sam: bisect artifacts attached to PR — commit 7f9b2a correlates with memcpy_count +2.5x and sync-prefetch count increase. marking as culprit in the bisect notes.
anil: follow-ups: (1) add unit test ensuring async prefetch for shortseq codepath, (2) emit metric `prefetch.sync_count` and `prefetch.sync_latency_ms`, (3) audit other uses of `sync_prefetch`.
maria: assigning tasks: sam -> deploy hotfix, anil -> tests + metrics, rachel -> monitor canary and update incident board.
rachel: thanks all — updating the incident tracker and linking this thread. we'll reconvene if hotfix doesn't bring metrics back in line.
